lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as a regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The clusters are arranged in vertical columns of 4 to 5 nodes, with the spatial distance between centroids increasing moving from the anterior (near gills) to the posterior (near caudal peduncle).
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define the grid structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition where lighter dorsal pixels meet a darker shadow line running parallel to the lateral line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the leading edge and the lower posterior margin.
